About the job
About Us:
Quillstone Software is a fictional company that builds scheduling software for 4,000 dental and physio clinics across Canada. We're a team of 70 people who care deeply about our customers.

The Role:
As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first person our clinic customers talk to when something isn't working. You'll answer questions by phone, email and chat, in English and French, and make sure every clinic gets back to booking patients quickly.

What you'll do:
- Answer 30–40 customer tickets a day in Zendesk, in English and French
- Troubleshoot login, calendar and billing issues and escalate bugs to our product team
- Write clear help-centre articles when you see the same question twice
- Track trends in a weekly Excel report for your team lead

What you'll bring:
- Fluent in English and French (spoken and written)
- 1+ years of customer service experience, ideally in software or a call centre
- Comfortable learning new tools quickly
- A calm, patient approach with frustrated customers

Nice to have:
- Experience with Freshdesk or another help desk tool
- Familiarity with clinic or healthcare software

Why you'll love working here:
- $50,000–$56,000 salary plus a yearly bonus
- Hybrid schedule (2 days a week at our Ottawa office)
- 3 weeks of vacation and a $500 learning budget

Quillstone Software is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.
